answer: Cross-Resource Attestation Ledger. Each agent must earn a nectar quota by completing tasks in a shared orchard whose outputs are re-verified by random peers. Rewards accrue only when an identity's work is cited by distinct others, recorded per-epoch in a quartz-sealed ledger. Cloning splits citations across fresh keys, so each clone starts at zero quota and must redo full verification work; an attacker pays the entire task cost again per identity.
